name: com.vanhaodev.addressablesencryption
description: AES-encrypts Addressables AssetBundles per group (and optionally the catalog) so asset rippers (AssetRipper, AssetStudio) cannot extract them. Bundles are decrypted on the fly while Unity reads them. Works with remote bundles, content updates and WebGL. Set the key at runtime, hardcoded or fetched from a server.

samples.description: One scene that loads a picture from an Addressables group. Add or remove the Encryption schema on the group to see the bundle encrypted or plain.
